product_overview: Wage Comparator is a web app that helps users compare a monthly salary against the salary distribution of a specific professional profile across European countries. Users can fill a three-step form, view an interactive box plot, add comparison countries, and access saved work through an account dashboard.
core_goals: Compare a salary against a relevant country-specific distribution without needing to sign up
Refine a professional profile through a guided three-step salary form
Compare the same profile across multiple countries in one view
Save form templates and comparison sheets for later reuse
Create an account, manage profile settings, and access dashboard content
View plan options and upgrade to Premium for expanded comparison access

features.name: Salary form basics
features.description: Users start on the home page and choose their base country, gender, and monthly wage to begin salary comparison.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the country selector and search for a country -> Select a country and see the chart load -> Select a gender -> Enter a monthly wage -> See the reference line appear on the chart -> See the next step become available
Navigate to / -> Open the country selector and search for a country -> Select a country and see the chart load -> Select a gender -> Clear the monthly wage -> See the next step become disabled

features.name: Salary form role and background steps
features.description: Users continue refining their salary profile through cascading role and background fields that shape the comparison data.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Complete the basics step -> Proceed to the role step -> Select an occupation -> Select an occupation level -> Select an economic activity -> Proceed to the background step -> Select an education level -> Select years of experience -> Select company size -> Go back and see previously chosen values remain in place

features.name: Interactive salary box plot
features.description: Users see a live box plot showing salary distribution statistics for the selected profile, including a reference line for their own wage.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> See the empty chart state with guidance text -> Select a country -> See the loading state -> See the box plot render with distribution statistics
Navigate to / -> Select a country -> Hover or tap the chart -> See the tooltip with maximum, upper quartile, median, lower quartile, and minimum
Navigate to / -> Enter a monthly wage -> See the wage reference line appear on the chart

features.name: AI-enriched salary estimates for small samples
features.description: When a selected profile has too few plausible salary records, the app enriches the distribution with an AI-generated estimate.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Select a rare country and profile combination -> Wait for the distribution to resolve -> See the chart render with the completed estimate

features.name: Form persistence across navigation
features.description: Users can leave the page or reload it and return to the same form step and selections later in the session.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Fill in part of the form -> Reload the page -> See the same step and values restored
Navigate to / -> Fill in part of the form -> Navigate to /about -> Return to / -> See the same step and values restored

features.name: Compare with other countries
features.description: Users can add additional countries to the same salary chart and remove them again within plan limits.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Select a base country -> Open the comparison flow -> Pick another country -> Add it to the comparison -> See the new country appear in the chart
Navigate to / -> Select a base country -> Open the comparison flow -> Add one or more countries -> Remove an added country -> See it disappear from the chart
Navigate to / -> Select a base country -> Open the comparison flow -> Try to exceed the country limit as a guest -> See the prompt to log in to compare more countries

features.name: Comparison sheet
features.description: Users can open a dedicated comparison page that summarizes the selected countries with multiple charts and plan-gated detail views.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Complete the three-step form -> Open the comparison sheet -> See the Comparison Sheet title, country chips, and four chart cards
Navigate to /comparison -> See the comparison sheet with summary charts for the selected countries
Navigate to / -> Complete the three-step form -> Open the comparison sheet -> See the prompt to upgrade for detailed data when using a free or guest plan

features.name: Guest login prompts
features.description: Guest users are prompted to log in or create an account when they try actions that require a signed-in session.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Attempt to fast fill from a saved template as a guest -> See the login prompt
Navigate to / -> Attempt to save the current form as a template as a guest -> See the login prompt
Navigate to / -> Attempt to save a comparison as a guest -> See the login prompt
Navigate to / -> Attempt to compare beyond the guest country limit -> See the login prompt

features.name: Authentication dialog
features.description: Users can log in, create an account, and recover their password through the authentication dialog.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the account menu -> Open the authentication dialog -> Switch between log in and create account modes -> Enter email and password -> Submit the form
Navigate to / -> Open the account menu -> Open the authentication dialog -> Enter incorrect credentials -> See an error message
Navigate to / -> Open the account menu -> Open the authentication dialog -> Choose forgot password -> Start the password recovery flow

features.name: Plans and pricing
features.description: Users can review Free and Premium plans and toggle between monthly and annual pricing displays.
user_flows: Navigate to /plans -> Toggle between monthly and annual pricing -> See the Premium price update
Navigate to /plans -> Attempt to upgrade as a guest -> See the prompt to log in to upgrade to Premium

features.name: Navigation and theme switching
features.description: Users can move through the public site, open the mobile menu, and switch between light and dark themes.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open About from the navigation -> Return to / -> Open Plans from the navigation -> Return to /
Navigate to / -> Toggle between light and dark theme -> See the interface update
Navigate to / -> Open the mobile side menu -> Close the side menu by tapping outside or pressing Escape -> See the menu dismiss
Navigate to / -> Open Privacy & Terms from the footer -> Return to /

features.name: Protected dashboard
features.description: Signed-in users can access a protected dashboard with saved items, settings, and plan management pages.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard with an active session -> See the dashboard cards and recent comparisons
Navigate to /dashboard without a session -> See the redirect back to /
Navigate to /dashboard/templates with an active session -> View saved templates
Navigate to /dashboard/comparisons with an active session -> View saved comparisons
Navigate to /dashboard/settings with an active session -> View profile settings and account controls
Navigate to /dashboard/settings/manage-plan with an active session -> View billing and plan details

features.name: Saved templates management
features.description: Signed-in users can save, load, and delete salary form templates from their dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Complete the three-step form -> Save the form as a template -> See the template saved message
Navigate to /dashboard/templates with an active session -> Open a saved template -> Load it into the home form -> See the form restored on step 1
Navigate to /dashboard/templates with an active session -> Delete a saved template -> Confirm the deletion -> See the template disappear

features.name: Saved comparisons management
features.description: Signed-in users can save, open, and delete comparison sheets from their dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Complete the three-step form -> Open the comparison sheet -> Save the comparison -> See the comparison saved message
Navigate to /dashboard/comparisons with an active session -> Open a saved comparison -> See the comparison sheet reopen with stored data
Navigate to /dashboard/comparisons with an active session -> Delete a saved comparison -> Confirm the deletion -> See the comparison disappear

features.name: Profile and account settings
features.description: Signed-in users can update their profile details, avatar, email, and password from account settings.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/settings with an active session -> Upload a profile image -> Change the display name or email -> Enter a new password if desired -> Save changes -> See the settings saved message
Navigate to /dashboard/settings with an active session -> Remove the current avatar preview -> Save changes -> See the updated profile settings

features.name: Delete account
features.description: Signed-in users can permanently delete their account from the dashboard settings danger zone.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/settings with an active session -> Open the delete account flow -> Confirm the deletion -> See the account deleted message and return to /

features.name: Manage plan and billing
features.description: Signed-in users can view their current plan, add a simulated payment method, and cancel Premium from the manage plan page.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/settings/manage-plan with an active session -> Open the payment method panel -> Enter card details -> Save the card -> See the payment method saved message
Navigate to /dashboard/settings/manage-plan with an active session -> Open the cancel subscription flow -> Confirm cancellation -> See the plan change back to Free

features.name: Product information pages
features.description: Users can read product details, data source information, privacy terms, and frequently asked questions.
user_flows: Navigate to /about -> Read the product overview, data source details, and FAQ
Navigate to /privacy -> Read the privacy and terms information

features.name: Not found and error recovery
features.description: Users are shown a not-found page for unknown routes and can return to the home page from there.
user_flows: Navigate to /this-route-does-not-exist -> See the page not found message -> Go back to home

tech_stack: Supabase (Auth, Postgres RPC, Storage, Edge Functions)

routes.description: Salary calculator. Three-step form (Basics, Role, Background) on the left and a live box plot on the right (chart on top in mobile).
Comparison Sheet with four chart cards. Needs navigation state from the form; direct access shows an empty sheet.
Plans and pricing (Free vs Premium) with Monthly/Annual toggle.
Destination of the signup confirmation email.
New password form; stays disabled until a valid recovery link session exists.
Dashboard with four cards and Recent Comparisons. Anonymous users are redirected to / without opening the login dialog.
Profile (avatar, name, email, password) and Danger Zone (delete account).
Current plan, simulated payment method, cancel subscription, billing history.
Page not found with a "Back to home" action.

features.name: Salary form step 1 - Basics
features.description: Choose Country (searchable combobox), Gender (Male/Female) and Monthly Wage. Each selection refetches data; wage only draws a reference line. "Next step" enables when all three have value.
user_interactions: Open the Country combobox and search by text
Select a country and see the loader and then the box plot
Select Gender Male or Female
Type a Monthly Wage and see the red dashed "Your monthly wage" line
Clear the wage and see "Next step" disabled again
Click "Next step"

features.name: Salary form steps 2 and 3 - Role and Background
features.description: Cascading comboboxes (Occupation, Occupation Level, Economic Activity, Education Level) whose options depend on previous selections, plus fixed lists Years of Experience and Company Size. Back keeps values.
user_interactions: Pick Occupation then Occupation Level then Economic Activity
Click Next step and pick Education Level
Pick Years of Experience (0-2, 3-5, 6-10, 10+ years) and Company Size (1-10, 11-50, 51-200, 200+ employees)
Click Back and verify values are kept

features.name: Box plot chart
features.description: One box per country (min, Q1, median, Q3, max) with colour legend chips, tooltip, explanatory legend and wage reference line. States - empty (logo and guide text), loading (rotating AI phrases) and ready. Salaries above 15000 EUR/month are discarded.
user_interactions: See empty state before choosing a country
See loader while data is fetched
Hover or tap the chart to see tooltip with Max, Q3, Median, Q1, Min

features.name: AI enrichment for small samples
features.description: When fewer than 8 plausible salaries return, the app calls the Edge Function enrich-salary-data (Gemini) and merges the estimate. Result cached per tab in sessionStorage. UI does not tell the user the data is estimated.
user_interactions: Select a rare combination of filters and wait for the estimated distribution

features.name: Form persistence in sessionStorage
features.description: Step, values and extra countries survive reload and in-app navigation (keys salary-comparator:form-step, salary-comparator:form-values, salary-comparator:extra-countries). Invalid stored fields are dropped individually.
user_interactions: Fill part of the form, reload and verify the same step and values
Navigate to /about and come back

features.name: Compare with other countries
features.description: Modal to add comparison countries (chips with remove button). Country limit is 2 for Guest and Free, 3 for Premium. Guest at limit sees login prompt; Free at limit sees upgrade dialog.
user_interactions: Button "Compare with another country" is disabled until a base country is chosen
Open the modal, pick a country, click "Add country"
Remove an added country with the x on its chip
Try to exceed the limit as guest and see "Log in to compare more countries"

features.name: Go to comparison sheet
features.description: From step 3, "Go to comparison sheet" navigates to /comparison with form values and countries. Sheet has Salary Distribution (Premium only, real data), Salary Growth, Sector Distribution and Occupation Salary Bands (Premium only) - last three use simulated data.
user_interactions: Click "Go to comparison sheet" on step 3
See title "Comparison Sheet", country chips and four chart cards
See "Upgrade to Premium for detailed data" as guest or free

features.name: Guest login prompts
features.description: Anonymous users get an AuthPromptDialog with Log In, Create an account and Maybe later when they try fast-fill from template, save as template, save comparison, or exceed the country limit.
user_interactions: Click "Fast fill with a template" as guest
Click "Save as a template" on step 3 as guest
Click "Maybe later" to dismiss

features.name: Authentication dialog
features.description: Dialog with modes Log in / Create an account, email and password, Continue with Google, disabled Continue with GitHub, and Forgot password? leading to Reset your password dialog.
user_interactions: Click the account icon in the navbar to open the dialog
Switch between Log in and Create an account
Submit with wrong credentials and see an error toast
Click Forgot password?

features.name: Plans and pricing
features.description: Header "Get the full salary picture", Monthly/Annual toggle (2.99 or 1.99 EUR/month for Premium), Free and Premium cards, Premium marked Recommended. Guest sees Free as current plan.
user_interactions: Toggle Monthly / Annual and see the Premium price change
Click "Upgrade to Premium" as guest and see "Log in to upgrade to Premium"

features.name: Navigation and theme
features.description: Desktop navbar (logo, About, Plans, theme toggle, account button); mobile header with side menu that closes with Escape or tapping outside. Footer with Privacy & Terms. Theme defaults to dark and is not persisted.
user_interactions: Click About and Plans in the navbar
Toggle light and dark theme
Open and close the mobile side menu
Click Privacy & Terms in the footer

features.name: Protected dashboard
features.description: Dashboard cards, Recent Comparisons, templates and comparisons management, settings, manage plan, delete account. All under /dashboard and require session.
user_interactions: Open /dashboard without session and be redirected to /
With session, open the four dashboard cards
Save, load and delete templates and comparisons
Add a simulated payment method to become Premium

features.name: Error handling
features.description: Unknown routes show "Page not found" with "Back to home". Render errors show "Something went wrong". Chart errors are isolated per card.
user_interactions: Visit an unknown URL and click "Back to home"

known_limitations.issue: Export (PDF, PNG, CSV) does not generate any file; the sheet passes an empty handler
known_limitations.impact: Clicking Export closes the dialog but nothing is downloaded

known_limitations.issue: The Upgrade to Premium button in the compare-countries and export upgrade dialogs only closes the dialog instead of navigating to /plans
Payment is simulated; Premium is a client-side flag in user metadata, billing history is never filled and renewal date is hard-coded
known_limitations.impact: No real charge; plan limits are only enforced in the client

known_limitations.issue: Salary Growth, Sector Distribution and Occupation Salary Bands charts use simulated data
known_limitations.impact: Values are not real Eurostat data

known_limitations.issue: Salary Distribution on the sheet uses the national aggregate without profile filters, so it can differ from the home box plot
known_limitations.impact: Numbers on / and /comparison may not match

known_limitations.issue: Visiting /comparison without navigation state renders an empty sheet with no message or redirect
If the salary query fails the chart stays on the loader with no error message or retry
Changing an earlier form field does not reset later fields
known_limitations.impact: A stale combination can end up with no real data and fall entirely to AI estimation

known_limitations.issue: Template and comparison limits (Free 1, Premium 4) are not checked when saving; empty names are accepted
known_limitations.impact: Limits only hide the "save new" button on management pages

known_limitations.issue: Theme preference is not persisted across reloads and toasts are always dark
Plans page free card shows "$0" while the rest of the app uses EUR
About page claims "20+ European countries" but the dataset has 11
Continue with GitHub is visible but disabled
Visiting /dashboard without session redirects to / without opening the login dialog
